scoring_justification: Recompute from raw total energies is not possible because the agent is not required to produce those raw energy files under the output contract; scoring relies on the reported formation energies and band gaps compared to paper values with tolerances and on relative trend checks.

outputs.description: Formation energies (eV) for N-, W-, and N/W-doped anatase under Ti-rich and O-rich conditions. Checker compares each reported value to hidden reference tolerances and verifies that the formation energies satisfy specific trend inequalities (e.g., N/W-codoping has lower formation energy than single W-doping under Ti-rich conditions).
Fundamental band gaps (eV) of pure anatase, N-doped, W-doped, and N/W-doped systems. Checker compares directly to paper-reported values with tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The formation energies and band gaps are compared to hidden paper-reported values with tolerances; structural trend inequalities are also verified. No recomputation from raw artifacts is performed. All scored values are derived from DFT runs using publicly available inputs and open-source software.

hidden_assets.purpose: formation energy and band gap gold values
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I and main text band gap statements
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's published numerical results
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All gold values are identical to the reported paper values for the same quantities and units
